title: The Last Watch
tagline: We hold the gate. Christ is King.
world: The Christian kingdom of Aldmere, about 1190, grounded and real: no magic, no monsters. The just old king is dead; Lord Varric Hale has bought the court with grain, silver and debt and had the Order of the Gate disbanded. Five broken knights keep their oath anyway, holding the stone gatehouse at Dunmarch that seals the only mountain pass, unpaid, through one long winter, against the Hollow Men (hungry raiding clans from the north). Below the pass lies Hollow Ford, the village where their families live. Their oath: "I hold the gate. I keep the watch. I fear no man, and I serve one King."
look: Real light only: forge fire, candle, torch, overcast daylight, low winter sun, moonlight on snow; never neon or magic glow. Textures: wet stone, rusted iron, wool, wax, mud, frost, horsehair, leather straps. Palette: iron grey, bone white, deep brown, ember orange; red is rare and means blood, wine or warning. The knights almost always wear their closed helms. Show a man doing something, not posing.

places.The Gatehouse at Dunmarch: the stone gatehouse sealing the mountain pass: wall walk, arrow slits, the iron-banded gate, the bronze gate bell, torchlight and wind
places.The Forge: the gatehouse forge: anvil, coals, sparks, armor and blades being repaired
places.The Chapel Ruin: a small stone chapel with its roof half fallen, one stained-glass window still whole, candles on a broken altar, snow drifting in
places.Hollow Ford: the village below the pass: mill, river crossing, mud lanes, warm lit windows, chimney smoke, children
places.Varric's Hall at Greymoor: a lord's feasting hall: rich food, wine, gold plate, furs, a great fire; warm and rich but rotten
places.The Tithe Barn: a dusty timber barn holding the Order's last grain sacks and coin chest, counted by candle in the ledger
places.The Winter Road: the snow-covered road through the pass: tracks in snow, pines, white silence

motifs: The gate bell (rung once at dusk: the watch is kept; three times: danger). The words "We hold." The Ledger of the Order's names. Bread broken in five.

cast.name: Ser Aldric of Dunmarch
cast.object: an iron gate key on a chain around his neck
cast.who: the last Captain of the Order, in his fifties, thirty winters on the gate
cast.wound: ten years ago he ordered a retreat that saved his men but let a village burn
cast.battle: responsibility, leadership, carrying the weight alone, obedience when it costs
cast.arc: from carrying everything alone to trusting his brothers and God

cast.name: Ser Rowan Ashby
cast.object: a single silver coin he turns between his fingers
cast.who: left the Order to sell his sword for money in the south; came back broke and ashamed
cast.wound: he left his wife Maren and son Tobin in Hollow Ford and sent home less every year
cast.battle: money, debt, provision, chasing more, leading his family
cast.arc: from chasing coin to a husband and father who stays, a steward of little

cast.name: Ser Garrick Vane
cast.object: a scorched gauntlet bound with rope
cast.who: the strongest fighter in the Order and the most dangerous to himself
cast.wound: his armor blackened in the village fire where his brother died; he blames Aldric and God
cast.battle: anger, revenge, the temper that wants to swing first
cast.arc: from rage to strength under control

cast.name: Ser Edmund Clare
cast.object: a worn wooden rosary wrapped around his sword hilt
cast.who: once the most admired knight; broke his vow in secret sin with a nobleman's wife, was cast out, and came back on foot to serve as the lowest man
cast.wound: shame; he thinks grace is for other men
cast.battle: lust, temptation, secret sin, shame, purity
cast.arc: from hiding in penance to walking in the light, forgiven

cast.name: Ser Tomas Wren
cast.object: a small carved wooden horse tucked in his belt
cast.who: the youngest, the one who never left; keeps the night watch alone
cast.wound: his young wife died of fever last spring; the wooden horse was for the child they lost with her
cast.battle: doubt, fatigue, loneliness, discipline when no one is watching
cast.arc: from going through the motions to the quiet backbone of the Order

supporting: Father Edric (old priest at the chapel ruin, the mentor). Lord Varric Hale (the antagonist: never shouts, always offers gold and comfort). Maren Ashby (Rowan's wife, runs the mill). Tobin Ashby (Rowan's son, about 10, wears a wooden helmet). Brann of the Hollow (the raiders' war-chief, feeding his own people).

episodes.title: The Decree
episodes.moment: A royal messenger nails the decree disbanding the Order to the gate door. Aldric reads it, pulls it down, and rings the bell at dusk anyway.

episodes.title: Five Stayed
episodes.moment: Aldric opens the Ledger of the Order by candle and crosses out forty names, one by one. Five remain. His brothers wait behind him in the dark.

episodes.title: The Coin
episodes.moment: Rowan stands at his wife Maren's door after years away, the silver coin in his fist, and cannot bring himself to knock.

episodes.title: The Offer
episodes.moment: In Lord Varric's warm hall, a bag of gold slides across the table toward Garrick's scorched gauntlet: pay to walk away from the gate.

episodes.title: The Night Watch
episodes.moment: Tomas keeps the watch alone on the wall in the rain, turning the carved wooden horse in his fingers. No one sees him.
episodes.battle: discipline when no one is watching

episodes.title: The Letter
episodes.moment: A perfumed letter arrives from the nobleman's wife. Edmund holds it over a candle flame in the chapel ruin.

episodes.title: Empty Granary
episodes.moment: Rowan counts the Order's last coins by candle in the tithe barn, then splits them and carries half down to the village.

episodes.title: Swing First
episodes.moment: Garrick catches a starving Hollow boy stealing bread from the patrol's saddlebag, raises his sword, and lowers it.

episodes.title: The Captain's Weight
episodes.moment: Aldric at the forge before dawn, hammering out the dents in every brother's armor before he touches his own.
episodes.battle: leadership and the burden carried alone

episodes.title: Tobin's Helmet
episodes.moment: Rowan's son Tobin, in a wooden helmet, copies his father's guard stance in the stable yard; Rowan kneels and corrects his grip.
episodes.battle: fatherhood and the example you set

episodes.title: The Second Offer
episodes.moment: Lord Varric offers to erase Edmund's disgrace and restore his name, if he leaves the gate. Edmund sets the rosary on the table and stands.

episodes.title: Tracks in the Snow
episodes.moment: First snow. On patrol, Tomas finds dozens of bootprints coming south toward the pass and kneels to read them.

episodes.title: Three Bells
episodes.moment: Tomas rings the gate bell three times. Below, the five knights arm in silence by torchlight.
episodes.battle: courage when the danger is real

episodes.title: We Hold
episodes.weather: snow falling through the broken roof, candlelight
episodes.moment: The five kneel in the chapel ruin, snow falling through the roof, and speak the oath together. A heavy blow hits the gate outside.
